notes:
Firefox support (the signed Firefox file follows once Mozilla signing is set up), plus everything from 1.9: automatic updates.

Automatic updates on? This version installs itself.
Not yet? Replace your folder with this ZIP, click ↻ in chrome://extensions, then settings → Updates → "Turn on automatic updates" and load the folder it shows once with "Load unpacked". From then on Video Grabber updates itself.

New users: download video-grabber-1.10.0.zip, unzip, open START HERE.html.
